summary: VEON Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a November 5, 2026 press release announcing an agreement to acquire a 33.75% equity stake, plus control rights, in JungoTV Holdco, Inc., the newly formed US holding company of Los Angeles-based Jungo TV, parent of the All Women's Sports Network (AWSN). No purchase price, per-share value, premium, financing or closing date was disclosed; the filing is a non-US issuer report mapped to a US 8-K-style current report. Jungo TV and AWSN retain LA headquarters and existing management, and VEON plans to roll content across Pakistan, Bangladesh, Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan and Ukraine. Watch for definitive terms, regulatory clearances and governance/control-right mechanics.
